note: Git-organised reels — use TikTok audio extracted to public/reels/music/. Each reel depicts current track length (full song later if licensed). No people-mids; AI slides or new stock only.

structure.reels: public/reels/{raw,slides,music}/ → out/reels/ (1080x1920) — kept distinct in git

reels.headline: The Storm Didn't Come to Drown You
bodyLines: The storm came to show you who calms it.
Peace is not the absence of waves.
It's the presence of His voice over them.
Keep rowing — He is in the boat.
reels.musicNote: TikTok 1000853416 (215s) — longest track, will loop/cut to 60s+

reels.headline: Be Still — He Is Already Working
bodyLines: You don't have to strive to be kept.
Stillness is not weakness — it's trust.
The same wind that shakes you obeys Him.

reels.headline: You Are Not Late — You Are Becoming
bodyLines: Your chapter 3 is not their chapter 10.
Stay the course — consistency beats intensity.
Your time is not late. It's being formed.
reels.musicNote: TikTok 1000853360 (48s) — depict 48s now, full song later

reels.headline: Get Up — Grace Meets Effort
bodyLines: You won't feel ready. Move anyway.
Rise — heaven is watching your yes.
